messages.subject: The aes in ggtree() is incompatible with geom_strip()
messages.subject_clean: The aes in ggtree() is incompatible with geom_strip()
messages.body_plain:
Hi, Prof. Yu,
I want to set the line types of a clade as dashed line, so add aes(linetype=group) in the ggtree() function. And I also want to add a strip annotation. But they are incompatible. If I remove the aes(), it works well. Could you please help me fix it? Thanks!

Yiwei

A reproducible example is

library(TDbook)
library(ggtree)
x <- tree_long_branch_example
m <- MRCA(x, 75, 76)
y <- groupClade(x, m)

ggtree(y,aes(linetype=group))+
  geom_strip(data=as_tibble(y),"1","10",label = "test",align=F,offset = 0.005,offset.text = 0.007)
# print "Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : object 'group' not found"

ggtree(y)+
  geom_strip(data=as_tibble(y),"1","10",label = "test",align=F,offset = 0.005,offset.text = 0.007)
#work well.

My ggtree version is 3.2.0.

messages.subject: Combining continuous and discrete character visualization in a circular phylogeny
messages.subject_clean: Combining continuous and discrete character visualization in a circular phylogeny
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
I have an ultrametric phylogeny and I'm interested in displaying associated discrete character data in a stacked barplot, and then a set of proportions as a continuous variable (similar to gheatmap). Is it possible to combine both the stacked barplot and the gheatmap in a circular phylogeny in ggtree?

All the best,
Ari
